# Writer's Edit

> > A comprehensive writing resource site offering guides on craft, storytelling, worldbuilding, and publishing for fiction writers at all levels.

Writer's Edit is a collaborative writing education platform founded by Malia Hamilton, Jessica A. McMinn, Aden Curran, and Rebecca Jean. The site provides in-depth tutorials, tips, and best practices across all aspects of creative writing, from narrative structure and literary devices to character development and fantasy worldbuilding.

## Key Topics

- creative writing
- story structure
- literary devices
- character development
- foreshadowing
- five-act structure
- fantasy worldbuilding
- fictional language creation
- plot development
- writing techniques
- novel writing
- character description
- world-building
- fiction writing
- writing guide

## Story Structure & Narrative Techniques

- [How To Write Your Story With A 5-Act Structure](https://writersedit.com/writing/how-to-write-your-story-with-a-5-act-structure): Guide to five-act structure by Aristotle and Freytag for narrative framework
- [Foreshadowing in Literature: Definition and Examples](https://writersedit.com/writing/literary-devices-foreshadowing): Guide defining foreshadowing with examples for plot development and narrative tension
- [10 Simple Ways To Hone Your Craft & Sharpen Your Writing Skills Today](https://writersedit.com/writing/10-simple-ways-to-hone-your-craft-sharpen-your-writing-skills-today): Writing fundamentals guide covering grammar, voice, and craft improvement techniques

## Character Development & Description

- [7 Tips For Describing Hands In Your Writing](https://writersedit.com/writing/7-tips-for-describing-hands-in-your-writing): Writing tips for character description and show-don't-tell body language techniques

## Fantasy Worldbuilding & Conlangs

- [How To Create A Fictional Language For Your Fantasy Novel In 8 Steps](https://writersedit.com/planning/how-to-create-a-fictional-language-for-your-fantasy-novel-in-8-steps): Step-by-step guide for conlang creation and fantasy worldbuilding with literary examples
- [Does My Fantasy Novel Actually Need A Map?](https://writersedit.com/planning/does-my-fantasy-novel-actually-need-a-map): Guide on maps as worldbuilding tools for fantasy novels with literary examples
- [How Is World-Building For A Short Story Different From A Novel?](https://writersedit.com/inspiration/how-is-world-building-for-a-short-story-different-from-a-novel): Comparative guide on worldbuilding approaches for short stories versus novels

## Publishing & Manuscript Preparation

- [What's The Difference Between A Synopsis, A Pitch And A Blurb?](https://writersedit.com/publishing/whats-the-difference-between-a-synopsis-a-pitch-and-a-blurb): Publishing guide distinguishing synopsis, pitch, and blurb for manuscript submission

## Writing Mindset & Productivity

- [8 Tips For Getting Back Into Writing After A Long Hiatus](https://writersedit.com/mindset/8-tips-for-getting-back-into-writing-after-a-long-hiatus): Motivation and productivity tips for overcoming writer's block after extended breaks
- [How To Build A Music Playlist For Writers](https://writersedit.com/mindset/how-to-build-a-music-playlist-for-writers): Tips for using music playlists to improve writing productivity and focus habits

## Optional

- [Writer's Edit – Page 2](https://writersedit.com/page/2): Archive page listing articles on character development and creative writing
- [Writer's Edit – Page 28](https://writersedit.com/page/28): Archive page with guides on self-publishing, interviews, and writing workshops
